title: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
title_en: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
author: Jonathan Kemper
summary_en:
Startup PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an updated version of its aggressively compressed language model. It's based on Qwen3.8-27B and takes up just 5.9 GB of memory, same as its predecessor. That's possible because of ternary quantization, where each weight can only be one of three values (−1, 0, or +1) instead of the usual 16-bit storage. At full precision, a model this size would need about 54 GB.

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
Washington has spent years stopping advanced AI chips from physically reaching China. It turns out the chips never had to travel at all.

On Monday, the US Commerce Department issued a rule aimed at Chinese companies that tap high-end AI hardware sitting in data centers outside China. The move lands hardest on Southeast Asia, a region that has been building server farms at a brisk clip.

The rule comes from the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, or BIS. It is an interim final
summary_en: The US Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued an interim final rule, effective around November 16, 2026, targeting remote access to high-end AI compute by Chinese entities at non-US data centers. Facilities providing significant compute, exceeding 12 million aggregate TPP, are required to implement enhanced due diligence and obtain licenses, facing potential trade restrictions for non-compliance.

He crafted budgets, paid vendors, handled property tax disputes, and served as the town’s zoning supervisor and presiding elections officer. summary_en: AI-powered automation is triggering a surge in public records requests across the U.S., forcing local agencies to handle significantly increased volume and scope. title: Rajiv Ramaswami to step down as Nutanix begins hunt for its next CEO
title_en: Rajiv Ramaswami to step down as Nutanix begins hunt for its next CEO
author: Mike Wheatley
content_snippet:
Rajiv Ramaswami is stepping down from his role as chief executive of Nutanix Inc., six years after he joined the hyperconverged cloud infrastructure company from its rival VMware Inc.

In a letter to company employees, Ramaswami (pictured) said he’s going to continue in the role for the time being while he works with Nutanix’s board of directors to identify a successor and assist with the transition. “After that, I will continue to serve as a senior advisor to the company for a period of time,”
summary_en: Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami has announced his departure, triggering a leadership search and a transition period where he will serve as a senior advisor. Despite beating Q1 expectations with a 15% revenue increase, the company's conservative full-year guidance triggered an 8% drop in after-hours stock trading.

author: Peter Baker
content_snippet:
By his own account, President Trump was watching the stock market slide and decided to stop it. He would take it upon himself to determine who should lead one of the nation’s largest companies. Never mind national security concerns, never mind the autonomy of the private sector. Mr. Trump would decide.

The president’s extraordinary intervention resulted in Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as chief executive of Nvidia on Monday, just 11 days after he was forced out amid a Chinese espionage scandal.
summary_en: President Trump forced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia after his 11-day ouster following allegations of ties to a Chinese intelligence asset. ai_analysis.briefing_en: Facing energy grid bottlenecks and years-long connection delays, data center developers are increasingly building on-site 'behind-the-meter' natural gas plants. Since 2025, announced projects have reached over 115 gigawatts of capacity, underscoring the urgent priority AI firms place on deployment speed over grid integration.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】数据中心开发者（如xAI等）在美国数据中心产业界：通过建设自有天然气发电厂实现离网供电，绕过电网连接审批流程
【起因与机理】现有电力基础设施无法承载AI激增的能耗，且电网升级审批过程极其缓慢
【核心事实细节】电力接入审批长达十年，迫使开发者选择自建能源供应。
【各方立场与态度】该模式具备高成本与高合规博弈特征，旨在换取极速算力部署时间。

content_snippet:
On the road that connects the villages to the north of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank, there is always a watchtower and a gate, often flanked by Israeli soldiers with machine guns around their necks. content_snippet:
French and U.S. authorities suspect Iran was behind a cyberattack targeting supermarket refrigerators and freezers across Europe, an incident that reportedly spoiled food and caused equipment failures, resulting in tens of millions of dollars in damage. The attack affected about 700 supermarkets, raising concerns about the exposure of connected refrigeration systems and the potential for cyber operations to disrupt essential commercial infrastructure.

France’s Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot

title: HPE Gives Outlook That Falls Short of Optimistic Estimates
title_en: HPE Gives Outlook That Falls Short of Optimistic Estimates
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that fell short of the most optimistic estimates …
summary_en: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $14.5 billion, a 50% year-over-year increase, beating analyst estimates of $14.3 billion.
